data_access.source: MLB StatsAPI schedule?hydrate=officials (one request per season)
data_access.requests_per_refresh: 2 for the full 2025+2026 frame (incremental afterwards: 0 when both seasons cached)
data_access.note: Savant/Statcast 'umpire' field is NULL in the installed pybaseball pull; the schedule hydrate=officials endpoint is the working umpire source (100% coverage).

runs_proxy_verdict.verdict: DON'T ADOPT as a model feature
runs_proxy_verdict.feature_tested: umpire's within-season trailing mean total runs over his prior games worked (window 25, min floor 10), leakage-free, 2025 and 2026 built separately
runs_proxy_verdict.robustness: expanding-window variant: 2025 beta -0.16 (t=-0.85), 2026 beta -0.15 (t=-0.55) — sign unstable across windows; same-series-excluded variant unchanged; umpire-identity ceiling R2 ~3-5% of runs variance
runs_proxy_verdict.reason: No material signal in either era -> the 45-fold blend ablation gate was never warranted (scoping rule).

called_strike_rate_on_non_borderline_pit.why: park-independent signal; needs zone/description pitch data (Statcast re-pull retaining those columns, ~1.3M pitches) joined to the StatsAPI umpire IDs
